description:
You are one of several planners at a logistics company choosing where to build a new regional warehouse. Each planner has surveyed different aspects of the candidate sites.

The options are:
- Site A (Dralyntal Yercasva)
- Site B (Ririnyer Yercas)
- Site C (Negarso Quocasva)
- Site D (Mosanith Socasso)

Exactly one option is best overall. Which site should be chosen? Your notes are incomplete: other participants hold information you do not have.
